messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content:
**Best months to visit Hawaii**

| Month | Why it’s a good time to go |
|-------|----------------------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny weather (average 26–28 °C / 79–82 °F). Rainfall is low, crowds are thinner than in summer, and hotel rates start to drop. |
| **May** | Similar to April—mild temperatures, less rain, and the peak tourist season hasn’t kicked in yet. |
| **September** | After the summer rush, the weather is still warm (26–28 °C / 79–82 °F), but the crowds thin out and prices fall. |
| **October** | Still warm and sunny, with even lower rainfall than September. Prices are at their lowest, and you’ll find great deals on flights and accommodations. |

### Quick weather snapshot (average highs)

| Month | Avg. High (°C) | Avg. High (°F) |
|-------|----------------|----------------|
| April | 27 | 81 |
| May | 27 | 81 |
| September | 27 | 81 |
| October | 27 | 81 |

*(These averages come from the Hawaii Climate Data Center; temperatures stay fairly consistent year‑round, hovering around 26–28 °C.)*

### Bottom line

If you’re looking for a balance of pleasant weather, fewer crowds, and better prices, **April, May, September, or October** are your best bets. Summer months (June‑August) are still warm but come with higher prices and larger crowds, while winter (December‑February) can bring occasional rain and cooler temperatures, especially on the windward side. Happy planning!
